=== update
$ orion-agent update

 ◆ Update                                                                0.9.2 → 0.9.3
 ╭ Steps ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── 3 of 5 ╮
 │ ✓ Downloaded                   24.1 MB                                     2.8 s   │
 │ ✓ Checksum matches                                                                 │
 │ ✓ Service stopped                                                                  │
 │ ⠹ Swapping binary                                                                  │
 │ ○ Starting and checking health                                                     │
 ╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
   ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━──────────────────  60%

  …and when it finishes the checklist collapses to:

   ✓ Updated to 0.9.3 in 14 s
     previous version kept · undo with orion-agent update --rollback

=== update  ·  fails and rolls back
$ orion-agent update

   ✓ Swapped binary
   ✗ New version is not healthy after 30 s
     │ exit status 1: state database migration failed
   ⠹ Rolling back…

   ✓ Rolled back to 0.9.2
     the host kept reporting the whole time · logs: orion-agent logs --lines 80

$ echo $?
1

=== update  ·  nothing to do, and rollback
$ orion-agent update

   ✓ Already on 0.9.3             nothing to do · --force reinstalls

$ orion-agent update --rollback

   ✓ Stopped service
   ✓ Restored 0.9.2
   ✓ Started and healthy

   ✓ Rolled back to 0.9.2

--- notes
NOTE Progress you can read: A checklist with one spinner and a real progress bar (bubbles/progress). It collapses to a single line when done.
NOTE Failure is calm: A bad update ends in Rolled back, not in an error. The previous binary is restored and the exit code still says it failed.
NOTE Flags: --version pins a release, --force reinstalls, --rollback restores the previous binary.
